card.name: Small words before QT or capacitor terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'using', 'of', 'the' and 'in' right after QT/QTc prolongation or ECG phrases. Also 'use' after capacitors, where a charging-related word is likely next.

modes.label: Capacitor text
modes.description: A verb or preposition in descriptions of capacitors and electrodes.
modes.example: Ultra capacitors<< use>> a “mechanical” charge system

card.writes: It promotes charge/charging words and suppresses failure-type words, which fits little here beyond the capacitor context.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in ECG QT-prolongation sentences and in capacitor descriptions.
